# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VOLUME_DROP

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a gap open >0.25%, if price begins to fill the gap and accompanying volume diminishes relative to pre‑gap average, the gap is likely to fade, offering a counter‑gap trade. This fades the initial gap momentum by betting on mean reversion when volume confirms lack of conviction in the gap direction.

## Mechanism

Define gap size as (open – previous close) / previous close. If |gap| > 0.0025 and price moves toward the previous close (for gap up, price falls below open; for gap down, price rises above open) within the first 30 minutes, and the 5‑bar average volume on those fill bars is < 70% of the average volume of the first 5 bars after open, enter in the direction of gap fill (long for gap down, short for gap up) at the close of the bar where the volume condition first is met. Exit: Stop at the opposite side of the gap (above gap‑up high for short, below gap‑down low for long); TP1 at 1R; runner using a chart‑stop at structure invalidation (e.g., new high beyond gap‑up high for a short). Regime hint: Works best when VIX < 20 and between 09:45‑11:30 EST; avoid high VIX days (>25) and major news windows.
